mapper.select: SELECT h.dateTime, COALESCE(d.dataValue, 0) AS dataValue FROM (SELECT '00:00' AS dateTime UNION ALL SELECT '01:00' AS dateTime UNION ALL SELECT '02:00' AS dateTime UNION ALL SELECT '03:00' AS dateTime UNION ALL SELECT '04:00' AS dateTime UNION ALL SELECT '05:00' AS dateTime UNION ALL SELECT '06:00' AS dateTime UNION ALL SELECT '07:00' AS dateTime UNION ALL SELECT '08:00' AS dateTime UNION ALL SELECT '09:00' AS dateTime UNION ALL SELECT '10:00' AS dateTime UNION ALL SELECT '11:00' AS dateTime UNION ALL SELECT '12:00' AS dateTime UNION ALL SELECT '13:00' AS dateTime UNION ALL SELECT '14:00' AS dateTime UNION ALL SELECT '15:00' AS dateTime UNION ALL SELECT '16:00' AS dateTime UNION ALL SELECT '17:00' AS dateTime UNION ALL SELECT '18:00' AS dateTime UNION ALL SELECT '19:00' AS dateTime UNION ALL SELECT '20:00' AS dateTime UNION ALL SELECT '21:00' AS dateTime UNION ALL SELECT '22:00' AS dateTime UNION ALL SELECT '23:00' AS dateTime) h LEFT JOIN (SELECT DATE_FORMAT(alarm_time, '%H:00') AS dateTime, ROUND(AVG(CAST(data_value AS DECIMAL)), 0) AS dataValue FROM device_data WHERE function_id = #{functionId} and iot_id=#{iotId} AND alarm_time between #{startTime} and #{endTime} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(alarm_time, '%H')) d ON h.dateTime = d.dateTime ORDER BY h.dateTime;

WITH RECURSIVE date_series AS ( SELECT DATE(#{startTime}) AS date_val UNION ALL SELECT DATE_ADD(date_val, INTERVAL 1 DAY) FROM date_series WHERE date_val < DATE(#{endTime}) ) SELECT DATE_FORMAT(ds.date_val, '%m.%d') AS dateTime, COALESCE(AVG(CAST(dd.data_value AS DECIMAL(10, 2))), 0) AS dataValue FROM date_series ds LEFT JOIN device_data dd ON DATE(dd.alarm_time) = ds.date_val AND dd.iot_id = #{iotId} AND dd.function_id = #{functionId} GROUP BY ds.date_val ORDER BY ds.date_val;
